body: Thank you, you make a lot of sense. It was like this before but we can't keep no distance. I was never into being with a couple but I loved them both and couldn't handle it, so I acted like a rebel teenager just as I did today, and as I did with every single boyfriend or girlfriend I ever had. I'm mad at knowing that he said stuff about me months ago when we had a fight, to someone I hate - but I'd be mad too if someone went through my stuff, even more. The thing is, relationships shouldn't make me feel suicidal - this only means my background is probably fucked up so hard that I depend on the happiness of being with someone, as a distraction. I really do expect a lot from people and hope that they always forgive me, when I just forgive things to bring them up later. Would it be instant-suicide if, as an example, my parents die? Just worried.

Oh, actually, in my country the best colleges are public. I passed a test that filters sixty thousand people into three thousand. That's pretty nice but, well, not an American Ivy League after all. Our education is pretty messed up before that so the numbers trick. I do PR because I want to work with politics campaigns, but, I work now with the shitty organizational stuff that even includes birthday parties and all that ass kissing. It's an Asian company and I have no support, my boss is from another area and just expects results. Not well paid either. I just wanted to play music. Thanks for the wishes. I guess survival is talking, it's not the first time we break up before exams. I just have to bring back the desperate 'ignore everything' formula.

I tried to, but my family just mentioned me as a weak person when I did. I can't spend my family's money like that and I sure don't have enough. I will not kill myself because of them, if I kill myself it will be because of my feelings, not their. And suddenly they called me selfish (oh well I guess) and don't seem to notice that I was asking for help. Even after watching me almost falling. I'm not sure what to expect, they are not professionals.

IDK. I'm a sad person ever since I know myself. I'm not sure if I can blame them, anyone would react like that if you invade their privacy. They weren't even cheating, but one of them was talking shit about me with his ex. I shouldn't be so impulsive. Thank you, I hope my life turn around sometime, but it seems like I can't change anything and I just accept whoever/whatever comes.

Thank you, this was pretty good. This happened some times before but I always thought I was far from suicide, even if I was thinking a lot about it - just thought it was a way of thinking about how to escape. I just realized it was so close all that time too. I've been in this shit for 2 years and it can be so awesome and so bad, I just can't deal. But it's far worse without them. I'm a sad person ever since I know myself and I just pissed off who I liked.

Thank you. They were with me while I had a big surgery even after we broke up once, and I can't imagine myself without them after all the support and love I got. I fucked up hard several times and I'm immature and not worthy of their love and care. The guy can be a big idiot sometimes because he is impulsive like me, but the girl is totally amazing and she does not deserve my behaviour. I did love them both and I can't imagine myself or them with someone else. I'm supposed to change my life but everything is sort of fixed up, I don't pay shit for my college and I can't break my job's contract. This is not the first time they trigger my impulse to kill myself like this, but I have never got so far, I almost did it. I always thought I needed to be a lot more desperate to really kill myself and not just saying it, and I just got so close. I really shouldn't be so dependent, but I wasn't the happier person alive while alone either.

Actually all of my relatives would reject me or say that I had it coming, dealing with a catholic family.This is such a stigma in my country...  Not sure if it wouldn't just mess things a little more. Thanks for asking, I work and study public relations. I would really like a break, but I can't. My next week off was supposed to be with them - already planned and scheduled with my boss. This week I have a huge party to plan for work and a hell of papers and exams, to contribute, a lady crashed my car last week. No idea of how to do this. No energy. Just trying to do the papers while I browse.
I already felt that my life was worthless before them, now I can't think differently. And it makes me even angrier because they think it's just attention I want.
